summary: This guide showcases early Season 9 Vortex level 59 setups for both Dauntless and Toxin teams. Team 1 runs a Dauntless composition featuring Maashtur as the highest HP frontline soak alongside Guinavivre, Nastjenka, Kurvida, and Selva on a 20-second skill rotation without Puppeteer gear. Team 2 utilizes a Toxin composition with Child of Chaos acting as the solo support alongside Twitch, Sleight, Sacredeia, and Serpentemis on an 18-second rotation. Sacredeia wears a Puppeteer set acquired early via Walker's Trail or Fey Meander.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Needs to be built with the highest HP on the Dauntless team to soak hits.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Equipped with her exclusive artifact and built prioritizing Critical Rate and damage.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Built with Rift Hourglass for Skill Haste and sufficient Accuracy to guarantee debuffs without needing an exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Utilized as the carrier for the 3-piece Puppeteer set to enable an 18-second team rotation.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Built stacking high Enlightenment (over 350) and Accuracy for maximum damage.

teams.note: Dauntless team running a 20.0s rotation without Puppeteer gear; Maashtur triggers at 12.0s, Kurvida at 12.6s, Guinavivre and Nastjenka at 13.0s, and Selva at 22.5s.

Toxin team running an 18.0s rotation enabled by Puppeteer gear on Sacredeia; Child of Chaos triggers at 11.5s, Serpentemis default at 12.0s, Sacredeia at 13.0s, Sleight at 13.1s, Twitch at 13.2s, and pet at 5.0s.

tips: Make sure Maashtur has the highest total HP on the Dauntless team so the boss targets him.
Prioritize getting high Enlightenment and sufficient Accuracy on Toxin heroes to maximize damage and debuff uptime.
If you obtain early Puppeteer gear pieces from Walker's Trail or the Fey Meander shop, you can lower team ultimate rotations to 18 seconds.
title: BE READY FOR WEEK 1! Level 59 Dauntless & Toxin Vortex Setup | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
